contentText:
Fans at Billboard’s R&B/Hip-Hop Power Players concert in New York share their favorite songs that help them get into motion.

Narrator: The Planet Fitness movement mixes celebrate the music that keeps us moving, and there’s no better place to tap into that energy than New York. During Hip-Hop and R&B Week, Billboard and Planet Fitness hits the streets to ask New Yorkers and music fans one question: What’s the song that keeps you moving, pushing and showing up? What song do we listen to to get in motion?

Fan: I’ma go Drake “Somebody Loves Me.”

Fan: To get you out of bed?

Fan: I listen to Drake to get in bed.

Fan: I would say “G.A.D” by Jada Kingdom gets me up in the morning.

Fan: Repeating Drake “Come Thru” like every morning.

Fan: Something by Lil Uzi. “Spin Again,” yeah. “Spin Again” by Uzi.

Fan: To get me through my workout, at the end of that workout, Kash Doll, “Power.” Oh, it’s gonna help me lift, help me, you know, hit my PR.

Fan: Megan Thee Stallion “Cobra.” That’s the song that I’ll put at the end to get it.

Fan: Chief Keef gets me through the end of the workout.

Fan: I mean, anything, Beyoncé, “Kitty Cat,” especially. Let’s go.

Fan: “G.O.M.D,” J Cole, yeah.

Fan: Get me in a good mood. I love me some throwback Cardi B. You know what I mean. I like listening to like you know, “Be Careful.”
